correctness.rationale: Two independent standard-library verifiers rebuilt GP(8,3) and checked the finite combinatorics and topology. Eight-vertex Alexander-dual K: 140 nonempty simplices, 67 acyclic pairs, 1 critical vertex, 4 critical two-cells and 1 critical three-cell, 424 directed covers and signed integral three-to-two boundary identically zero; hence K is wedge of 4 S² and S³ and Tsukuda Cor.4.11 gives its suspension. Direct Ind(G): 1090 faces, 541 acyclic pairs over 4272 covers, critical (1 in degree0,5 in degree3,2 in degree4) and integral critical boundary columns (0,0,1,-1,0)^T; primitive rank-one cancellation leaves wedge of 4 S³ and S⁴. All modular boundary ranks independently verified. Acyclicity exhaustive on finite face posets, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical sixteen-vertex cubic symmetric incidence graph of an (8_3) configuration, so its ordinary independence complex is a mathematically natural object. Determining the exact mixed-dimensional integral homotopy decomposition and zero attaching map fills information not implied by known independence numbers or suspension theorems. The 140-face dual reduction is an explicit reusable case for topological incidence methods, and the direct 1090-face integral check corroborates it. The value is its natural complete homotopy classification, not mere code/reproducibility.
